title: The identity sequence converges uniformly to the identity function on any [a,b]
statement: For any a, b : CReal, CReal.UniformConvergesOn (fun n x => x) (fun x => x) a b -- the constant sequence of identity functions converges uniformly (trivially, with rate independent of both n and the point) to the identity function on the interval [a,b]. The first concrete instance of CReal.UniformConvergesOn, dispatched via its own entry point separately from uniform_converges_geom_half.

formal.statement: theorem CReal.uniform_converges_id : ((x0 : CReal) -> ((x1 : CReal) -> CReal.UniformConvergesOn (fun (x2 : AxNat) => fun (x3 : CReal) => x3) (fun (x2 : CReal) => x2) x0 x1))
